title: narcissus tazetta subsp. intermedius
intro: Narcissus tazetta subsp. intermedius, commonly known as the Chinese snowflake, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus tazetta subsp. intermedius include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
